menu_options.microsoft: A Microsoft account (Outlook calendars and To Do lists)

board.title: The household and its homes
board.description: Name the household and the two homes it lives between. The board shows every time on both homes' clocks whenever they differ.

calendars.title: Which calendars feed the board
calendars.description: All optional, and all changeable later under Configure. People's own calendars are set on each person. Trips are also found by their titles (flight numbers, ferry, train) on everyone's calendars. Sign a Microsoft account in first if the calendars you want are not here yet.

data.birthday_calendars: Birthday calendars (Outlook's Birthdays, or a shared one)
data.events_calendars: Events board calendars (what you have tickets for)
data.trips_calendars: Trip calendars (every event on these is a journey)

microsoft.title: Sign a Microsoft account in
microsoft.description: Work, school or personal (Outlook.com, Hotmail). The next screen shows a code to type in on your phone; the account's calendars and To Do lists then become entities here. The defaults are the Family Hub app registration.

data.tenant: Tenant (common, organizations, consumers or a tenant id)

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Microsoft will no longer refresh {account}'s access. Press Submit for a new code and sign in again on your phone.

pick.title: Calendars and lists
pick.description: Signed in as {account}. Pick what this house should see. The name goes in front of the entity ids (calendar.mark_calendar); use the same name in every house so the ids match.

progress.signin: On your phone or laptop, open {url} and enter the code **{code}**, then sign in as the account you want to connect. This screen moves on by itself once the sign-in is approved. The code is good for 15 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Microsoft could not be reached. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: There is already a Family Board, or that Microsoft account is already signed in.
abort.signin_declined: The sign-in was declined on the other device. Nothing has been connected.
abort.signin_expired: That code expired before it was used. Start again for a new one.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Microsoft account from the one this entry was set up with.

init.title: Family Board
init.description: The homes, the calendars and the tuning. Points are read off a chore's title, for example "Bins (2 pts)"; a chore without one is worth the default.

data.trip_pattern: Trip pattern (regular expression matched against titles and locations)
data.board_days: Days the Events board looks ahead
data.default_points: Points for a chore with none in its title
data.count_vanished_as_done: A chore that disappears from its list counts as done

account.title: Calendars and lists
account.description: Signed in as {account}. Pick what this house should see.

abort.not_loaded: This account is not loaded; sign in again first.

user.title: Add a person
user.description: Their calendars give them a column on Today; their to-do list is their chores. A birthday here puts them on the birthdays list with their age.

error.already_configured: There is already somebody with that name.

user.title: Add a birthday
user.description: Somebody the house keeps a date for and nothing else: a grandparent, an uncle, a school friend. They get no column and no chores, just the date every year.

error.already_configured: There is already a birthday for that name.
